spec_match.rationale: Enum values (1 AllowSubApps / 2 BlockSubApps / 3 AskSubApps, unset ⇒ 3) and the Blocked ≻ Allowed ≻ Default precedence are taken verbatim from Chromium's policy_definitions/ContentSettings/*.yaml, including the isolated-app:// example origins.

interactive.rationale: Radio group plus two list-membership checkboxes recompute the verdict, rationale, and policy JSON on every change; copy button exports the JSON.

blurb_alignment.rationale: Index blurb promises a precedence-correct decision tool with copyable JSON; delivered.

edge_cases.rationale: Covers blocked-list-overrides-allow-list, unset-equals-ask, block-default with no lists, and the all-unset case (emits an explanatory comment instead of empty JSON).

references.rationale: Feature index cites https://chromestatus.com/feature/6260680824061952 and links all three chromeenterprise.google policy entries.

conformance.rationale: The suite's policy-exempt-origin-skips-prompt manual assertion encodes exactly the matrix this planner computes; automatable context assertions pass live.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Headless Chromium 141 CDP run: exercised allow-default, blocked-list-override, and block-default paths — verdicts and JSON matched the policy semantics; zero console errors; 0px overflow both classes after fixing a 7px mobile overflow (panel min-width); screenshots read.

telemetry_health.rationale: subapps-planner-verdict asserts every recompute lands in the {allow, block, ask} vocabulary.

design_system.rationale: Verdict colours emerald/rose/amber on stone background (AA); CSS variables only; native radios/checkboxes.

accessibility.rationale: Fieldset/legend groups with labelled radios and checkboxes; the verdict box is aria-live; copy feedback is role=status.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: Two-panel grid collapses under 760px; long policy names wrap (overflow-wrap on labels/legends, min-width:0 panels); verified 0px overflow at 360×740 DPR3 after the fix.

openQuestions.title: Validate the matrix on a managed ChromeOS profile
openQuestions.detail: The planner's verdicts follow the policy definitions, but the end-to-end behavior (prompt shown / silent / blocked) can only be confirmed on a managed ChromeOS device with the policies applied and an installed IWA.

guidanceConsulted.query: radio group fieldset legend accessible policy chooser
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Group related choices in fieldset/legend with programmatic labels.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Both the enum and list membership use fieldset/legend with labelled native inputs.

guidanceConsulted.query: live status readout updates aria-live region
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Announce recomputed verdicts via live regions.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: The verdict box is role=status aria-live=polite and re-announces on every change.

guidanceConsulted.query: responsive two panel layout small screens no overflow
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: min-width:0 on grid children and wrapping for long tokens.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Applied after the mobile matrix caught a 7px overflow: panels get min-width:0 + border-box, labels/legends get overflow-wrap:anywhere; re-verified 0px.

summary: Verified headlessly (no chrome-devtools-mcp in this cloud session): all three precedence paths exercised with correct verdicts and generated JSON on Chromium 141; a real 7px mobile overflow was caught by the matrix, fixed, and re-verified to 0px. On-device managed-profile confirmation is recorded as the open question.
